name: plonetheme.clara
description: Frontend build for plonetheme.clara. Compiles the single theme bundle theme/scss/clara.scss (Bootstrap 5.3 folded in and driven from the public --plone-* runtime contract, the whole @layer cascade, semantic states, and the §7 $spacers remap) into src/plonetheme/clara/static/clara.min.css. Run `pnpm install` to fetch Bootstrap and compile. Bootstrap is pinned exactly to Plone 6.2's 5.3.8.
